options.title: The Giant Hidden Under a Field Near Tokyo
options.first_line: Under a field outside Tokyo, something huge is hiding. How far down?
options.first_frame: A quiet suburb outside Tokyo at noon with cars passing, the ground cut away under the street showing the tops of giant stone pillars, the depth meter at zero.

options.title: Tokyo Hid a Cathedral Underground. How Deep?
options.first_line: Outside Tokyo, there's a door in a field. What's under it?
options.first_frame: A suburban street outside Tokyo with traffic, a small door building on a field, the rock below cut away, the depth meter at zero.

options.title: What Tokyo Built Under Its Suburbs
options.first_line: Tokyo buried something enormous under its suburbs. How deep does it go?
options.first_frame: The suburbs outside Tokyo at noon, cars rolling, the camera beginning to tip down into the ground, the depth meter at zero.

why: A names a place you can picture and asks how far down something huge hides without giving the answer, and its first frame of giant stone pillars under a quiet street makes you ask what this is even with the sound off, while B's title already gives away the cathedral and C is the vaguest.
